description: This file defines functions for converting project name sets from manifest data into a TypeMap, distinguishing common and distinct projects, and aggregating project information.

methods.name: ProjectNamesToType
methods.description: Converts a ManifestFileGroup into a TypeMap, categorizing projects as common or distinct.

methods.name: extractProjectNames
methods.description: Extracts project names from a ManifestFile into a slice of strings.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Creates a map from project names to project types, differentiating common and distinct projects.
